Oneliner

Technical demonstration of extending orbital life with a PPT (Pulsed Plasma Thruster) propulsion system.
Description

Orbital demonstration content and human resource development

  1. Technical demonstration of extending orbital life with a PPT (Pulsed Plasma Thruster) propulsion system.
  2. Technical demonstration of OBC, which is a highly integrated, multi-functional, high-performance, and readily available commercial microcomputer.
  3. Demonstration of a new standard of optical wireless bus, which will be essential for high-density next-generation CubeSats.
  4. A new system in which many students from technical colleges will participate in satellite operation and mission accomplishment, inheriting the know-how from KOSEN-1/2.
